name: invisible stalker
desc: Invisible Stalker is a CR 6 elemental.

actions.name: air form
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can enter an enemy's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

actions.name: invisibility
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has the &Reference[Invisible apply=false] condition.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes three [[/item .mmWindSwipe00000]] attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of [[/item .mmVortex00000000]].

actions.name: vortex
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=cZy0VYbCVY8aRB4z]], one [[lookup @target.affects.special activity=cZy0VYbCVY8aRB4z]] in the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s space. Failure: [[/damage average activity=cZy0VYbCVY8aRB4z]] damage, and the target has the &Reference[Grappled apply=false] condition (escape DC [[lookup @skills.ath.passive]]). Until the grapple ends, the target can't cast spells with a Verbal component and takes [[/damage average activity=kDz92inkRCjGrPiz]] damage at the start of each of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s turns.
